name: condorcet_minimal_predecessor_reciprocal_completion_integer_weights
lines: m q k : ℕ
hk : 0 < k
R : Fin m → Fin m → Prop
H : Fin q → Fin q → Prop
f : Fin m → Fin q
hroot : ∀ (J : Finset (Fin m)), #J ≤ k → ∃ a ∉ J, ∀ b ∈ J, R a b
hminimal : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin m)), (∀ J ⊆ S, #J ≤ k → ∃ a ∈ S, a ∉ J ∧ ∀ b ∈ J, R a b) → S = univ
hmap : ∀ (a b : Fin m), R a b → H (f a) (f b)
hrepair : ∀ (T : Finset (Fin m)), #T = k + 1 → (¬∃ a ∉ T, ∀ b ∈ T, R a b) → ∃ x, ∀ a ∈ T, H x (f a) ∧ H (f a) x
⊢ ∃ w, ∀ (A : Finset (Fin q)), (WellFounded fun a b => H ↑a ↑b) → 2 * ∑ a ∈ A, w a < ∑ a, w a
F : Finset (Finset (Fin m)) := {T | #T = k + 1 ∧ ¬∃ a ∉ T, ∀ b ∈ T, R a b}
hF : F.Nonempty
⊢ F.Nonempty
T : Finset (Fin m)
hTc : #T = k + 1
hTb : ¬∃ a ∉ T, ∀ b ∈ T, R a b
hcard : ∀ T ∈ F, #T = k + 1
hcomplete : ∀ (T : Finset (Fin m)), #T = k + 1 → (¬∃ a ∉ T, ∀ b ∈ T, R a b) → T ∈ F
hex : ∀ (T : ↥F), ∃ x, ∀ a ∈ ↑T, H x (f a) ∧ H (f a) x
⊢ ∀ (T : ↥F), ∃ x, ∀ a ∈ ↑T, H x (f a) ∧ H (f a) x
T : ↥F
⊢ ∃ x, ∀ a ∈ ↑T, H x (f a) ∧ H (f a) x
g : ↥F → Fin q
hg : ∀ (T : ↥F), ∀ a ∈ ↑T, H (g T) (f a) ∧ H (f a) (g T)
w : Fin q → ℕ
hw : ∀ (X : Finset (Fin q)), (WellFounded fun a b => H ↑a ↑b) → 2 * ∑ x ∈ X, w x < ∑ x, w x

steps.tactic:
classical
let F : Finset (Finset (Fin m)) := univ.filter fun T => T.card = k + 1 ∧ ¬∃ a, a ∉ T ∧ ∀ b ∈ T, R a b
have hF : F.Nonempty :=
  by
  obtain ⟨T, hTc, hTb⟩ := condorcet_minimal_predecessor_undominated_extension m k R hroot hminimal
 …
let F : Finset (Finset (Fin m)) := univ.filter fun T => T.card = k + 1 ∧ ¬∃ a, a ∉ T ∧ ∀ b ∈ T, R a b

have hF : F.Nonempty :=
  by
  obtain ⟨T, hTc, hTb⟩ := condorcet_minimal_predecessor_undominated_extension m k R hroot hminimal
  exact ⟨T, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hTc, hTb⟩⟩
obtain ⟨T, hTc, hTb⟩ := condorcet_minimal_predecessor_undominated_extension m k R hroot hminimal
have hcard : ∀ T ∈ F, T.card = k + 1 := fun T hT => (mem_filter.mp hT).2.1

have hcomplete : ∀ T : Finset (Fin m), T.card = k + 1 → (¬∃ a, a ∉ T ∧ ∀ b ∈ T, R a b) → T ∈ F := fun T hc hb =>
  mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hc, hb⟩

have hex : ∀ T : { T : Finset (Fin m) // T ∈ F }, ∃ x : Fin q, ∀ a ∈ T.val, H x (f a) ∧ H (f a) x :=
  by
  intro T
  exact hrepair T.val (mem_filter.mp T.property).2.1 (mem_filter.mp T.property).2.2

obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ :=
  condorcet_minimal_predecessor_integer_reciprocal_separator m q k hk R H hroot hminimal F hF hcard hcomplete f g hmap
    (fun T a ha => ⟨(hg T a ha).2, (hg T a ha).1⟩)
